MSG_ASSET_TAB_SETTINGS_DESC: Reorder or hide unused tabs, and set the default tab that opens when using "{ACTION_CHANGE_ARTWORK}"
LABEL_SQUARE_CAPSULES_DESC: Use square capsules instead of portrait ones. Square filters will be automatically selected.
LABEL_UNIFORM_RECENT_DESC: Make the most recently played game on the home screen match the rest of the capsules.
LABEL_CAPSULE_GLOW_DESC: Adjust capsule glow intensity in the library.
LABEL_SETTINGS_DISABLE_MOTD_DESC: Announcements are used sparingly to display important information or community events.
MSG_RESTART_STEAM_DESC: Steam needs to be restarted for the changes to take effect.
MSG_FILTER_TAG_NSFW_ENABLED: Might wanna do a quick shoulder check.
LABEL_BEGGING_MODAL_DESC: Please consider donating to help with maintenance and server costs!
MSG_ASSETS_FILTERED: Some assets may be hidden due to filter
MSG_ASSET_APPLY_ERROR: There was a problem applying this asset.
PA_COVER_HINT: Portrait or square, used in the library
PA_INSTALLED_ARTWORK: Artwork currently installed for this game
PA_NO_RESULTS_SOURCE: No results from {source} with the current filters
PA_PERFECT_BANNER_REMOVED: Perfect Banner removed; Steam banner restored.
PA_OPTIMIZE_BANNERS_DESC: Adds missing banners and upgrades low-resolution ones to 920 × 430.
PA_RESET_DESC: Covers, banners, backgrounds, logos and icons are restored to Steam defaults. Steam downloads them again automatically.
PA_KEY_BACKEND_UNCONFIRMED: The key was not confirmed by the backend.
PA_TRY_RESTART: Try again after restarting the plugin.
PA_TAGLINE: Covers, backgrounds and logos. Exactly how you want them.
PA_CENTER_HOME_HERO_DESC: Useful with the Playhub theme, which aligns the hero to the top.
PA_PERFECT_HERO_DESC: Background and logo merged into a single 3840 × 1240 hero.
PA_PERFECT_BANNER_DESC: Background and logo merged into a single 1926 × 900 banner, matching Steam proportions at high resolution.
PA_PROVIDER_SGDB_DESC: Community artwork, official assets, styles and animations. Cover shape is determined by the selected resolutions.
PA_PROVIDER_PLAYSTATION_DESC: Official PlayStation covers, key art, screenshots and logos.
PA_PROVIDER_IGDB_DESC: Covers, artwork and screenshots from IGDB.
PA_PROVIDER_NINTENDO_DESC: Official Nintendo square covers, key art and screenshots.
PA_PROVIDER_XBOX_DESC: Official Xbox covers, key art, screenshots and icons.
PA_PROVIDER_IIDB_DESC: Banners, heroes, logos and icons from iiDB.
PA_PERFECT_HERO_REMOVED: Perfect Hero removed; the Steam hero and separate logo have been restored.
PA_PERFECT_HERO_APPLIED: Perfect Hero applied. The separate logo has been hidden.
PA_REOPEN_PLUGIN: Return to the library and reopen Playhub Artworks.
PA_MISSING_LOGOS_DESC: Adds a logo to games that do not have one.
PA_SOURCE_ORDER_DESC: Search active sources in the order below and use the first suitable result.
PA_PERFECT_HERO_QAM_DESC: A Perfect Hero merges background and logo into one image so the logo stays visible from Home when using the Playhub CSS Loader profile. ZazaMastro heroes are already prepared; Playhub Artworks creates the composition automatically for other games.
PA_REMAKE_PERFECT_HERO_DESC: Heroes for all games will be regenerated, including those already correct.
PA_REPLACE_ALL_COVERS_DESC: Current covers for all games will be replaced. Games without a new cover remain unchanged.
PA_NO_BACKGROUND_GAME: No background is installed for this game.
PA_LOGO_CONTROLS_HINT: Directional buttons: size · LB/RB: anchor · B: close
PA_WHAT_EDIT: What do you want to edit?
PA_NO_LOGO_COMPOSE_BG_ONLY: This game has no logo, so only the background will be composed.
PA_LOGO_EXCLUDED_DESC: The logo is not merged into the image; Steam keeps displaying it over the background.
PA_COMPOSER_CONTROLS_HINT: LB and RB adjust the size from anywhere. Closing with B saves the composition.
PA_GAME_SUGGESTIONS_DESC: Suggestions come from {source}. Change the title if the results do not match.
PA_EXACT_DIMENSIONS_DESC: Only artwork with these exact dimensions.
PA_COVER_SHAPE_DESC: Only keep images that match the library layout you want.
PA_CONTENT_DESC: Clean promotional artwork or in-game screenshots.

PA_ERROR_INTERNAL_ARTWORK: The artwork operation could not be completed.
PA_ERROR_ARTWORK_TOO_LARGE: This artwork is too large to process safely. Choose a smaller image.

PA_ERROR_API_KEY_SETTINGS: Enter your SteamGridDB API key in Playhub Artworks settings.
